Hala Badri, Director General of Dubai Culture and Arts Authority (Dubai Culture), visited the Ars Electronica Center in Linz as part of the Authority’s official delegation visit to Austria. The visit aims to strengthen engagement with international cultural and creative institutions and explore opportunities for collaboration and knowledge exchange in culture, digital arts and emerging arts. The delegation is also participating in the Ars Electronica Festival, taking place in Linz until 13 September, as part of Dubai Culture’s efforts to keep pace with global developments and build international partnerships that support Dubai’s cultural and creative ecosystem.

The Government of Dubai Media Office hosted the second session of its International Media Briefing series, featuring Paul Griffiths, Chief Executive Officer of Dubai Airports. The discussion explored the resilience of Dubai’s aviation sector, its key priorities and the long-term development plans shaping its future. The briefing brought together leading international and local media for a discussion on DXB’s growth, expanding connectivity, the development of Al Maktoum International (DWC), and plans to transform the passenger experience through technology. @DXB | @DubaiAirports
